	# WKR late war: opens once the war has run eighteen months.
	#
	# After eighteen months the Worker republic has one lever left: call
	# the last levy and then choose whether to spend it going forward or
	# to bury it in the interchange.
	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

	focus = {
		id = WKR_throw_the_reserves_forward
		icon = GFX_focus_WKR_throw_the_reserves_forward
		search_filters = {
			FOCUS_FILTER_ARMY_XP
			FOCUS_FILTER_WAR_SUPPORT
		}
		x = 6
		y = 1
		relative_position_id = WKR_republic_fights_as_one
		cost = 3
		prerequisite = { focus = WKR_republic_fights_as_one }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = WKR_dig_in_along_the_interchange }
		allow_branch = {
			tag = WKR
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_collapse
				has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_regional_consolidation
				has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_central_preparation
				has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_central_showdown
			}
		}
		available = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				WKR_administration_active = yes
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_central_preparation
					has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_central_showdown
				}
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = WKR_final_operation_council_tt
				any_owned_state = { WKR_railway_council_site = yes }
			}
		}
		cancel_if_invalid = yes

		completion_reward = {
			unlock_decision_tooltip = WKR_breakthrough_programme
			custom_effect_tooltip = WKR_breakthrough_unlock_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 100
			modifier = { factor = 2.5 surrender_progress < 0.20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 surrender_progress > 0.45 }
		}
	}

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	# WKR legitimacy: earn it slowly or spend it for a battlefield.
	#
	# Worker legitimacy is earned on the shop floor. Seat the councils,
	# then either publish real production returns and be believed, or
	# requisition in the republic's name and be obeyed instead.
	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

	focus = {

		}

				has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_regional_consolidation
				has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_central_preparation

			ADISCORD_vorkerland_wkr_seat_council = yes

			modifier = { factor = 2 has_war = yes }
		}
	}

		}
